# BBSI Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results


November 04, 2026 4:05pm EST[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_c07c33e0189d5b04c6ea515c2d618288/bbsi/news/2026-11-04_BBSI_Reports_Third_Quarter_2026_Financial_409.pdf)


## Related Documents


[Earnings Webcast Audio](https://viavid.webcasts.com/starthere.jsp?ei=1768401&tp_key=2be17111f0)


- Revenues up 5% to $334.1 Million and Gross Billings up 3% to $2.40 Billion -


VANCOUVER, Wash., Nov. 04, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Barrett Business Services, Inc. (“BBSI” or the “Company”) (NASDAQ: BBSI), a leading provider of business management solutions, reported financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026.


**Third Quarter 2026 Financial Summary vs. Year-Ago Quarter**


- Revenues up 5% to $334.1 million.
- Gross billings up 3% to $2.40 billion.
- Average worksite employees (“WSEs”) up 0.6%.
- Net income of $16.8 million, or $0.69 per diluted share, compared to net income of $20.6 million, or $0.79 per diluted share.


“BBSI delivered third quarter results in line with our expectations, reflecting continued execution against our controllable growth initiatives and disciplined operational management,” said Gary Kramer, President and CEO of BBSI. “Although client hiring trends remain soft, we are encouraged by improving conditions in the workers’ compensation market and our continued ability to secure rate increases. Combined with consistent execution across our controllable growth initiatives, these trends position us to build on our operating foundation as we move into 2027. We remain focused on disciplined growth, delivering value to our clients and strengthening our platform for long-term success.”


**Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results**


Revenues in the third quarter of 2026 increased 5% to $334.1 million compared to $318.9 million in the third quarter of 2025.


Total gross billings in the third quarter of 2026 increased 3% to $2.40 billion compared to $2.32 billion in the same year-ago quarter (see “Key Performance Metrics” below). The increase was driven by growth in professional employer (“PEO”) services, primarily resulting from increased WSEs from net new clients, as well as higher average billings per WSE per day.


Workers’ compensation expense as a percent of gross billings was 2.4% in the third quarter of 2026, which included favorable prior year liability and premium adjustments of $0.8 million. This compares to 2.2% in the third quarter of 2025, which included favorable prior year liability and premium adjustments of $3.9 million.


Net income for the third quarter of 2026 was $16.8 million, or $0.69 per diluted share, compared to net income of $20.6 million, or $0.79 per diluted share, in the year-ago quarter.


**Liquidity**


As of September 30, 2026, unrestricted cash and investments were $73.7 million compared to $67.9 million as of June 30, 2026. BBSI remained debt free at quarter end.


**Capital Allocation**


Continuing under the Company’s stock repurchase program established in August 2025, BBSI repurchased $9.0 million of common stock in the third quarter, comprising 273,695 shares at an average price of $33.01. At September 30, 2026, approximately $31.2 million remained available under the $100 million repurchase program.


The Company paid $1.9 million of dividends in the quarter, and BBSI’s board of directors confirmed its next regular quarterly cash dividend at $0.08 per share. The cash dividend will be paid on December 4, 2026, to all stockholders of record as of November 20, 2026.


Through a combination of stock repurchases and dividends, year-to-date capital returned to shareholders totaled more than $50 million.


**Outlook**


The calendar-year outlook for 2026 is as follows:


- Gross billings growth of 3% to 4%.
- Growth in the average number of WSEs of 1% to 2%.
- Gross margin as a percent of gross billings of 2.70% to 2.75%.
- Effective annual tax rate to remain at 26% to 27%, excluding the one-time charge related to prior-year tax credits.

**About BBSI**


BBSI (NASDAQ: BBSI) is a leading provider of business management solutions, combining human resource outsourcing and professional management consulting to create a unique operational platform that differentiates it from competitors. The Company’s integrated platform is built upon expertise in payroll processing, employee benefits, workers’ compensation coverage, risk management and workplace safety programs, and human resource administration. BBSI’s partnerships help businesses of all sizes improve the efficiency of their operations. The Company works with more than 8,200 PEO clients in all 50 states. For more information, please visit[www.bbsi.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=X2SCxf-A7NQLEazdJSYyN_OA8WszlwKGgx4tIx53BdZ8dUVDBvXpNUi1GpzMgmW-kgm_Jnl_uMA23Ws_NllsGQ==) .
